mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 1-month change) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to bonds.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the 1-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5%, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days due to the immediate market reaction to tight monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the unemployment rate is below 3.5%, the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to the combined pressure of monetary tightening and a tight labor market, which signals an overheating economy and potential recession.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND UNRATE < 3.5 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5) and strong labor force growth (PAYEMS > 155000), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 20 trading days because a tight labor market supports wage growth and corporate earnings expansion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 3.5 AND PAYEMS > 155000 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index (INDPRO) level is positively related to S&P 500 returns: a higher INDPRO (indicating stronger industrial activity) predicts positive returns over the next 60 trading days because it signals robust economic growth that supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above its historical median (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 units, S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 5 trading days because a decline in housing activity signals a weakening economy and reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1400 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 1400 and retail sales (RSAFS) are below 680000, the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to a combination of weak housing and consumer spending, which signals a broad economic slowdown.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1400 AND RSAFS < 680000 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeds 102.5, it signals strong industrial activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 102.5 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
